counterfactual_missing_items: No associated lower extremity edema, orthopnea, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, chest pain, palpitations, dizziness, or lightheadedness
Normal left ventricular ejection fraction of 60% to 65%
decisive_items: Lentiform fat signal mass between lateral wall of ascending thoracic aorta and medial wall of SVC measuring 2.8 cm × 1.5 cm
3.1 × 2.3 × 3.0 cm well-defined mass within the lower SVC with extension to the interatrial septum
Lipomatous hypertrophy of the interatrial septum present
response.rationale: C1 best combines the fat-signal mass identity with SVC localization, matching the CT/MRI mass and TTE lipomatous hypertrophy. R1 captures the secondary SVC narrowing and flow acceleration but lacks the underlying tissue diagnosis; R2 is a less complete version of C1 without SVC anatomy.

rejected.why: Shares the same fat-signal evidence as C1 but omits SVC localization, making it less complete.
